title: [11/5/2024] A town centre in 1990 and the same town centre today
prompt: The maps below show a town centre in 1990 and the same town centre today. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The maps illustrate the changes that have occurred in a town centre between 1990 and the present day.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the most significant changes include the replacement of individual shops with a large shopping mall and the transformation of residential houses into apartment blocks with the addition of pedestrian crossings.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: In 1990, the northern side of Smith Street contained a row of individual shops including a newsagent's, grocer's, baker's, butcher's, and cafe, along with a childcare centre and two banks. Today, all these individual shops have been consolidated into a single shopping mall, while the childcare centre remains unchanged. In addition, one of the banks on Oldfield Street has been converted into a cafe.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Turning to the southern section, it featured a row of houses along Green Street, with a park, library, and town hall in the middle of the town centre in 1990. However, the houses have now been replaced by modern apartment blocks, while the remaining locations maintain their original positions. The area has become more pedestrian-oriented with the addition of zebra crossings on both Green Street and Oldfield Street.
